text:
sarah: Quick follow-up on the ingress backpressure / retry slimline proposal — I sketched an approach that tries to give customers visibility into queue pressure without adding a ton of tracing noise. TL;DR: surface a compact header + sampled telemetry, and add an opt-in streaming trailer for resumed streams. Thoughts?

alex: Love the goals. Two quick concerns — 1) how expensive is emitting queue depth on every request? 2) does a header leak tenancy info for multi-tenant deploys?

sarah: Good call. For (1) the idea is to emit the header synchronously but only at dispatch time (cheap atomic read). For sampling we rely on a separate metric exporter that scrapes aggregate histograms every 10s, not per-request network calls. For (2) header contains only numeric pressure and window id, no tenant id. e.g. `X-Edge-Backpressure: lvl=2;q=42;win=34`

jamie: Example header looks fine. How do we map lvl -> action? Is lvl=3 a hard reject or soft-signal to callers?

sarah: Proposal: lvl=0 (healthy), 1 (mild — prefer small batching), 2 (deferable — prefer retry with backoff), 3 (shed — only high-priority requests/health allowed). We document semantics and strongly recommend idempotency checks for any requests that may be retried.

mike: Streaming case: if client sees lvl climb mid-stream, do we send a trailer to indicate partial output and a resume token? That gets tricky with resumable tokens and billing.

sarah: Exactly. My thought: add an opt-in trailer channel `Edge-Resume` only for models/routes that enabled resumable semantics. Trailer would be emitted when we decide to preempt or checkpoint: `Edge-Resume: token=abc123;offset=1024;q=2` — it's optional and gated by route config.

alex: Billing question: if we emit a resume token and client replays, do we re-bill from token boundary or re-evaluate? We need a clear billing contract.

sarah: Contract proposal: resumed calls are billed only for new tokens generated after resume. We store minimal checkpoint metadata (route, model version, token window id) for N minutes. That matches current resumable contract in other infra pieces.

jamie: Observability: what do dashboards look like? I want to see per-route queue histogram + sampled request traces with the header value. Not raw every-request traces.

sarah: Exactly — metrics pipeline: aggregate histograms (q depth, admit latency), and sample traces when lvl>=2 or when the resume trailer is emitted. We add a new dashboard tile: "Ingress pressure heatmap" and an alert for sustained lvl>=2 above 60s.

mike: Retry interactions: clients will likely implement fast retries on 5xx. How do we avoid retry storms when lvl=2? Can we return a 429 with a retry-after that encodes backoff hints?

sarah: We prefer soft signaling first (header). If we need to force behavior, we can return 429 + `Retry-After` and include `Edge-Backoff: base=200;jitter=0.2` as a hint. The header-only path is non-disruptive for clients that already back off.

alex: Any perf numbers? atomic read for queue depth + header format seems cheap but we should benchmark. Also need an opt-out for dedicated customers who want zero header additions for compliance.

sarah: Bench plan: microbench dispatch hotpath with header on/off, measure p50/p99 and CPU delta. Feature flags: `edge.backpressure_headers.enabled` per deployment and `route.backpressure.visibility` per-route/tenant.

jamie: Ops concerns: sampling rules need to avoid bias toward long requests. Suggest sample by admission event not completion event. Also tag sampled traces with `backpressure_lvl` and `admit_bucket`.

sarah: Agreed. We'll sample at admit time; tag with level and queue snapshot. That lets us join with latency histograms.

ops-bot: RFC-1293 applied to staging (edge-backpressure-trial). Canary rollout scheduled for tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

mike: One more: for resumable trailers, we need to define token entropy and expiry. Don't want tokens replayable after model changes.

sarah: Token rules: include model-version hash + window id, short expiry (5m), single-use idempotency nonce optional. We'll add a migration path for model rollovers (invalidation).

alex: ok, sounds actionable. Can you drop the minimal API doc + k8s flag and I'll take the microbench task?

sarah: Yep — I'll push a short spec into the RFC branch now: header format, trailer schema, sampling rules, feature flags. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

jamie: Nice. Add a note to docs about "sensible defaults" for SDKs so clients don't overreact to lvl=1.

sarah: Will do.

mike: I'll review the trailer schema tomorrow.

ops-bot: canary started for cluster edge-test-3 at 02:00 UTC — 10% traffic.
